sourceTitle: Aunt Teri's Super Secret Spaghetti Sauce
sourceText:
Aunt Teri's Super Secret Spaghetti Sauce
By: Teri Davis Newman
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 12:03am

Ingredients




1 pound to 1.5  ground beef
15 ounces cans any cheap tomato sauce
6 ounces can tomato paste
1 teaspoon Basil
2 teaspoons garlic powder
1 tablespoon Italian Seasoning blend (Spice Islands)
1 bay leaf
2 teaspoons fennel seed
1/4 cup sugar (trust me)
1 teaspoon accent
crushed red pepper (for hot and spicy, optional)

Brown the beef, add the rest of the stuff, bring to a bo
cool, boil. When ready to serve, cook you favorite pasta shape according to the directions on the box. R

Preparation

1 Brown the beef. 2 Add the rest of the stuff. 3 Bring to a boil. 4 Cool 5 Boil, 6 Cool 7 Boil 8 Cool until ready to serve (trust me--this "ages" the sauce) 9 When ready to serve, cook you favorite pasta shape according to 10 The directions on the box. Reheat the sauce and ladle over the cooked drained pasta.

About


I first started playing with this recipe when I was 10 years old.  I'm now 50 and I perfected it when I was about 24 and have been serving it for 40 years to raves and pleadings for the recipe which I have always been happy to share.  I've never understood why people won't share a recipe.  A shared recipe lives forever, a hoarded one dies with you.
